info.title: EnvSync Management API
info.description:
EnvSync Management API documentation

Bearer-token clients can optionally send the `X-EnvSync-Org-Id` header to select an active organization for that request. Cookie sessions continue to use `envsync_active_membership`, and API-key requests ignore this header.

XEnvSyncOrgIdHeader.name: X-EnvSync-Org-Id
XEnvSyncOrgIdHeader.description: Optional. Bearer-token clients can use this to select the active organization for the request. Ignored for cookie sessions and API keys.

allowed_subjects.description: Subject patterns to allow (glob matching). Empty = allow all subjects from this issuer.
